description: Golden vectors for the encoded-H.264 record kind (issue #4787), shared byte-for-byte by the Swift ScreenCaptureCoreTests and the TypeScript frameProtocol tests. Each record is header(24) + payload; recordHex is the exact wire bytes. Discriminator: width=0, height = encodedVideoHeightBase(0xE2640000) | keyframeBit, bytesPerRow = payload length, timestampMs = presentation timestamp (ms) from the CMSampleBuffer PTS. Regenerate with scratch/genGolden.ts if the format changes; both suites must stay in lockstep.

resync.description: A corrupted keyframe record (field byte at offset 8 flipped, so the CRC-32 no longer validates) followed by a valid delta record. A decoder must report exactly one checksum mismatch, then recover and decode the delta record.
